messages:
jamie: quick async check — finishing quarter OKR milestone roundup. pls paste 1) what actually shipped vs target, 2) any slips + root cause, 3) ownership for next steps. keep it 1-2 lines each. @sofia @pranay @lia @carlos
sofia: Runtime v2 latency target: shipped canary perf tests and 90p95 dashboard. target: full canary -> prod by EOD next week. slipped: rollout to eu due to infra quota (AZ assignment). owner: @sofia. next steps: infra ticket open (INFRA-789), CC @carlos. :white_check_mark:
pranay: Model catalog UI: shipped list view + filters. target: inline model performance summary (beta) — slipped by 1 sprint because PR#457 needed UX polish. owner: @pranay. next: finish UX tweaks, merge PR, run perf smoke. ETA: 3 business days. :mag:
lia: Dedicated capacity billing UI: core flows shipped, but metering edge cases slipped (large-batch jobs causing misbilling). root cause: missing tokenization of batch keys. owner: @lia. next steps: patch in billing lambda (SPEC-234), run retrograde billing job, notify affected customers. ETA: 5 days. :warning:
carlos: Redwood Optimize suggestions engine: shipped cheap-quant suggestion pipeline and telemetry. slipped: quality A/B (regression in hallucination) so rollback to previous heuristic. owner: @carlos. next: triage sample prompts, add evals to CI, re-run canary over subset. PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/optimize/pulls/22
jamie: tiny ask — for slipped items put a one-line mitigation so PMs have direction. also add any cross-team deps (infra, security, docs).
sofia: infra dep: NEED quota bump from cloud team for eu g3 pools — @carlos can you raise with infra ops? I've attached error log snippet: ```ERROR: failed to allocate GPU: no AZ capacity in region-eu-west-1a```
carlos: on it, raised INFRA-800, pinging ops. also linking runbook for temporary fallback: `/runbooks/serving/fallback-to-smaller-vm`.
pranay: docs dep: docs/feature-catalog needs short blurb about performance profiles — assigning to @lia to write devex blurb, will include screenshot.
lia: ack, will draft and drop in #docs-drafts by EOD tomorrow.
jamie: code-review pings: @pranay can you take a quick look at PR#461 (runtime telemetry changes) — low risk. @sofia please verify canary dashboard query for p95 matches prod calc.
pranay: I can review PR#461 today, aiming noon.
sofia: will reconcile dashboard math by tomorrow morning.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary/runtime-v2 -> cluster-a (job id: dpl-8821). logs: https://deploys.internal/dpl-8821.
carlos: small note — Optimize rollback observed lower cost but worse QA on docs-heavy prompts. we'll add targeted evals for docs-type prompts in the next sprint. owner: @carlos.
jamie: thanks all — i'll synthesize into OKR tracker. if anyone expects different ETA update here. otherwise i'll mark shipped/slipped in tracker later today. :thumbsup:
